# xg2g raw transport to video facts corpus, format version 1
#
# Generated. To change it, edit videoTSCorpusCases() in
# backend/internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/videots_corpus_test.go and run
#   go test ./internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/ -run TestVideoTSCorpus -update-video-ts-corpus
#
# A case is raw MPEG-TS and what a media core must report for it:
#
#   program <n>     the programme the core is constructed to follow
#   chunk <hex>     one ingest of these bytes, at the offset the previous ones reached
#   target <n>      one change of the programme being followed
#   event rap offset=<n> joinable=<0|1>
#                   a random access point the preceding call emitted, in order;
#                   offset is the caller's byte coordinate of the packet that
#                   began the access unit's PES packet
#   event identityEv  a programme identityEv change the preceding call emitted
#   facts ...       the video facts after the preceding call, where stated:
#                   ps ParameterSetsSeen; irap intra rpsei predrej unread the
#                   RandomAccess counters; vscr vclr vrun the video scrambling
#                   observation; cleanrap CleanEntryPoints; cleanau
#                   CleanAccessUnits; scrconf ScrambledVideoConfirmed; vpid and
#                   codec the stream the table names. The last step always
#                   states them.
#
# Events belong to the call that emitted them. Where a call begins and ends
# is otherwise not part of the case: the same bytes cut into other calls
# emit the same events under the same steps and leave the same facts, which
# is a test of its own rather than a line in this file.
#
# A case carrying `diverges <class>: <why>` is one where the reference does
# something else. Its `ref-event` and `ref-facts` lines are the reference's
# whole answer; the `event` and `facts` lines stay the authored one. The
# class says what kind of difference it is: defect, quirk, limitation or
# divergence. None of them is adopted.
version 1

  program 1
  chunk

  event identity

  facts ps=1 irap=1 intra=0 rpsei=0 predrej=0 unread=0 vscr=0 vclr=1 vrun=1 cleanrap=1 cleanau=0 scrconf=0 vpid=0100 codec=h264
end
